stage0001b_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Right, that's it for today!
　Man, second year really does
　turn the math up a notch.」

stage0001b_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$恭子$$
「Kana, you said the exact same thing
　back in first year.」

stage0001b_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$恭子$$
「And not just math. Physics, chemistry...」

stage0001b_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Uh, ahaha.
　A-anyway! To help the new class bond,
　how about we all go for karaoke?」

stage0001b_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$詩織$$
「Ooh, good call!
　Should we ask some of the boys too?」

stage0001b_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$かなめ$$
「We can show you around the area too.」

stage0001b_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I mean, $$第２新東京市$$ is a whole
　research campus city, all these schools
　packed together. People watch this place.」

stage0001b_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You only just transferred in.
　You can't know your way around yet, right?」

stage0001b_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$詩織$$
「Bit of a cold fish, isn't he...」

stage0001b_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$恭子$$
「I heard he grew up overseas.
　Maybe he just isn't used to it here...」

stage0001b_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Came back from abroad, huh...
　Hearing that, I can't just leave him alone.」

stage0001b_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$恭子$$
「You are the class rep, Kana.
　Always looking after somebody.」

stage0001b_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$詩織$$
「Still, $l...
　He does have a certain something.」

stage0001b_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$恭子$$
「Mm. The other classes are
　talking about him too.」

stage0001b_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That shadow he carries around,
　never saying anything about himself...
　I suppose it looks mysterious.」

stage0001b_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$恭子$$
「See, Kana...
　You are interested, aren't you?」

stage0001b_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...Honestly? A little.
　But he's not really my type.」

stage0001b_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Ah... Chidori.
　Has $l already gone home?」

stage0001b_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Oh, yes.
　He was here just a moment ago.」

stage0001b_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$恭子$$
「Perfect timing!
　Miss $$スズネ$$, why don't you
　come to karaoke with us?」

stage0001b_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$$恭子$$!
　Call her Miss Saijou properly.」

stage0001b_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$スズネ$$
「There are two Saijou teachers at this
　school, so for a student teacher like me,
　Miss $$スズネ$$ is just fine.」

stage0001b_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Then I'll take you up on that.」

stage0001b_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$かなめ$$
「It really is impressive though,
　what you're doing, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

stage0001b_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$恭子$$
「Yes!
　Being picked as a 《$$特別教育実習生$$》
　with a full year placement means...」

stage0001b_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I don't know about talented,
　but I did work hard at university.」

stage0001b_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「And it let me do my placement here in
　《$$第２新東京市$$》, which makes me very happy.」

stage0001b_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$詩織$$
「Still, the 《$$新世時空震動$$》
　changed the world all over again...」

stage0001b_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$恭子$$
「But that's why $$第２新東京市$$
　exists at all, isn't it?」

stage0001b_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$スズネ$$
「《$$ＵＣＷ$$》 and 《$$ＡＤＷ$$》 merged, and
　a new Earth Federation was born...」

stage0001b_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That we can build order and society
　like this, in spite of the quakes -
　I think that's human strength.」

stage0001b_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$かなめ$$
「We were lucky, though.
　The worlds that fused had such similar
　cultures that there was no real chaos.」

stage0001b_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「True.
　And the experts say the dimensional
　boundary is more stable than ever...」

stage0001b_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$スズネ$$
「The world will likely stay as it is
　for another few decades.」

stage0001b_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So the multiverse that started with
　the 《$$大時空震動$$》 gets a full stop.」

stage0001b_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$恭子$$
「You sound a little sad, Kana.」

stage0001b_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...It's a terrible thing to say, but
　I might be the type who can't live
　without a little excitement.」

stage0001b_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Hehe...
　A high school life that looks dull now
　can be thrilling when you look back.」

stage0001b_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$恭子$$
「Is that from experience, Miss $$スズネ$$?」

stage0001b_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$詩織$$
「By the way, Miss $$スズネ$$...
　weren't you looking for $l?」

stage0001b_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Oh, no!
　...Sorry, Tokiwa.
　I do need to speak with $l.」

stage0001b_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$恭子$$
「Alright. We'll hear about your own
　school days another time, then.」

stage0001b_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$スズネ$$
「You all go and enjoy
　your karaoke.」

stage0001b_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Just don't stay out too late.」

stage0001b_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...She really is adorable,
　Miss $$スズネ$$.」

stage0001b_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$恭子$$
「Mm. We got lucky, having her
　assigned to our class.」

stage0001b_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$詩織$$
「The boys are even happier than we are.」

stage0001b_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$恭子$$
「And that same Miss $$スズネ$$ is chasing
　after $l... Feels like the start
　of some kind of incident.」

stage0001b_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$かなめ$$
「N-now then. Shall we ordinary schoolgirls
　who claim to want excitement
　go and let loose at karaoke?」

stage0001b_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ is fine.
　Otherwise you can't tell me apart
　from the other Saijou.」

stage0001b_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...You don't have to answer
　if you'd rather not...」

stage0001b_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I read the essay you wrote in class,
　and I wondered, $l, whether you're
　interested in the occult...」

stage0001b_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$スズネ$$
「It can't be...!
　A spacequake, here!?」

stage0001b_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$n
「Where is this...
　Did the spacequake pull me in...」

stage0001b_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$n
「So I die... here...
　Knowing nothing, able to do nothing...」

stage0001b_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$n
「If I'm chasing something absurd,
　then I'll use absurd means myself...」

stage0001b_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$n
「With that power... with $$ジェニオン$$,
　even I can fight...」

stage0001b_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「THAT BLACK MATRIX YOU TOUCHED IS
　THE $$ＤＥＭ$$ PILOT AUTHENTICATION SYSTEM.」

stage0001b_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「YOU HAVE BEEN CHOSEN AS
　THE MONITOR OF GENION.」

stage0001b_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I AM $$ＡＧ$$.
　AN AGENT OF THE 《$$ＤＥＭ$$》 CORPORATION.」

stage0001b_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「THE D-TRADER IS NOT YET UNLOCKED
　IN THIS SCENARIO, SO...」

stage0001b_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「THIS D-TRADER SCENARIO WILL NOT BE
　SHOWN EITHER, BUT IT IS INCLUDED
　TO KEEP UP APPEARANCES.」
